retired.marker: RETIRED — NOT PRESENT IN CURRENT CONSTITUTION
retired.reason: Force-majeure termination trigger (60 days). The Constitution states no force-majeure position: §31.14-C names force majeure only as one of six circumstances permitting shorter notice, and fixes no period.
retired.ruling: owner, 2026-09-14: 'The eight standards that are not defined in the current approved Constitution must be retired … Do not use them in active LegalMind reviews. Do not show them as approved standards. Preserve their historical/reference record.' The set is seven, not eight — see the AM-59 r5 correction in AM-65.
retired.note: The file is kept, and `ratified` is left as it was: this standard WAS ratified from a LeapSwitch document on that date, and the historical Findings that cite it stay readable (rule 17). _legal_rule_note: PRIYEN'S RULE (owner 'change and update', 2026-11-16; replaces the zero-tolerance ruling of 2026-08-19/20 for client changes). Better for us or no change for us is accepted without a Legal Decision; only what is worse goes to Legal. MATCH -> ACCEPTABLE; a deviation -> UNACCEPTABLE -> Legal, except a deviation on this standard's declared favourable side (favourable_direction, from a source; never with favourable_counsel_check) -> ACCEPTABLE, still a DEVIATION (AM-239). No tolerance bands. effect_rule lets a client change the engine proves better or unchanged for us be accepted automatically, audited, reopenable by Legal.
